snippet.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall | Inside Screen Burn Part 1 (with subtitles) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
Go behind the scenes of SILENT HILL: Townfall with Screen Burn, the development studio based in Glasgow.
This first part features a candid look at the team, their studio, and the atmosphere behind the creation of the game, as originally shown during SILENT HILL Transmission.
